messages.subject: missing geom_curve() ?
parts:
In Table A.1 of Hadley's ggplot2 book (in appendix section A.3.2 on
page 189), it lists a ggplot2 layer called "geom_curve()" that should
have equivalent functionality to "curve()" but I do not seem to have
geom_curve() defined in my version of ggplot2. All 12 of the other
geoms in the table are defined, but not geom_curve().

Does anyone know if geom_curve() exists anywhere? It looks like it
would be exactly what I need, so I was glad to see it mentioned in the
book, but disappointed to not find the function in the package.

Thanks!

Josh.
